title: Three Saturdays and One Short Cap
subtitle: 人物描写 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人物描写（人与自我·生活与学习·人物与故事）
meta: 主题语境：人物描写（人与自我·生活与学习·人物与故事）　|　核心词汇：guy　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 guy 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the neighbour ① trusted a guy that no cousin on the street would have described, and he said the trusting was the whole of the Saturday. The ② guy, meaning the man himself and not the cap, ran three Saturdays and stayed undescribed in the book; a guy, he said, is the only thing on a street that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ guy on that street had the same short step beside him, and the ④ guy at the far gate, meaning the one they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A guy, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the neighbour said the describing is the part that fills three Saturdays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the guy was the whole of the matter, meaning the fellow and not the man. The ⑥ guy, meaning the fellow and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; guy, he said, is either something you trust or the only word that means both a man and a fellow. He said the fellow is the part they remember.

By 1984 the ⑦ guy had become a line in a note, and the note had become an argument about the short step. The ⑧ guy of the whole thing, the neighbour wrote in November, was one street and three Saturdays of describing; guy, he said, is either the one at the far gate or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ guy I remember is the one described in the note, which closed in 1986 and is still described as the quietest on the street. A ⑩ guy, my mother said in 1988, is the only one that improves by being described; every guy, she said, is a fellow that has agreed to look like a man. She said the fellow was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 家伙；伙计（指街上每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 家伙；男人（指那个人本人，与帽子相对）
C. 固定搭配：trust a guy 信一个家伙
D. n. 伙计（指留给孩子们学着处的那一个）
E. n. 伙伴（抽象总称，指一条街上的伙伴之事）
F. n. 家伙（指便条里写到、被记下的那一个）
G. n. 同伴；兄弟（指一件事里人人都认却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 情分（抽象总称，指人人都认却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: trusted a guy that no cousin on the street would have described
The guy, meaning the man himself and not the cap
the guy at the far gate
the guy was the whole of the matter
the guy had become a line in a note
The guy of the whole thing
A guy, my mother said in 1988

answers.why: trust a guy 意为“信一个家伙”，1979 年那位邻居信了一个街上没有一位表亲肯描述的家伙。
guy 意为“家伙、男人”，指那个人本人而不是帽子，他经过了三个星期六而在簿子上没有被描述。
guy 意为“家伙、男人”，指街上每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一步矮矮的步子。
guy 意为“伙计”，指最远那道门口留给孩子们学着处的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
guy 意为“同伴、兄弟”，指一件事里人人都认却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位兄弟就是那件事的全部。
guy 意为“情分”，指人人都认却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个家伙，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
guy 意为“家伙”，指便条里写到、被记下的那一个，到 1984 年这一个成了便条里的一行。
guy 意为“伙伴”，邻居十一月写道，整件事的伙伴之事是一条街和三个星期六的描述。
guy 意为“家伙”，我记得的是便条里描述过的那一个，1986 年搬走了，至今仍被说成街上最安静的一个。
guy 为抽象总称，母亲 1988 年说，一个家伙是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的伙伴。
